verdict.rationale: A SaaS incorporation service could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only fixed workflow automation, such as auto-filing Form SS-4 and 83(b) elections and prefilling fields. Nothing shows an AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. A community comment comparing Atlas to 'an advisor' is a metaphor for the guided process, not evidence of an AI agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
